items.text:
Quarterly sales report — EMEA, Q3. Overall revenue reached €18.6M, a 4.2% increase over Q2, with the strongest gains in the DACH region and Benelux. The enterprise segment grew 11% following the launch of the Atlas renewal program, while SMB declined 2% due to seasonal churn. Gross margin improved to 34.1% from 33.0%, mainly from lower cloud hosting costs after the migration to the Frankfurt data center. Headcount in sales stayed flat at 84. The report notes that pipeline coverage for Q4 is 2.9x, slightly below the 3.2x target, and recommends a targeted campaign for the Nordics. A separate annex covers product-line profitability and will be circulated next week.
